host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p xtask site 2>&1
cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: grep -n '<section id=' xtask/src/site.rs | head -30; head -20 CHANGELOG.md; grep -n '' docs/design/explainer-site.md | tail -15
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p xtask site 2>&1 | tail -30
cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|panicked|assertion"
cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -n 5

cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1 | rg "test result|FAILED|panicked"; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | rg "warning|error|Finished"; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1 | rg "test result|FAILED"

cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1 | grep -c FAILED; cargo test -p xtask 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|panicked"; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | grep -E "warning|error|Finished"

cargo fmt --all; cargo test -p xtask > /tmp/x.log 2>&1; echo $?; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings > /tmp/c.log 2>&1; echo $?; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors > /tmp/m.log 2>&1; echo $?
